title: Vendetta Platform escalation
description: What a module POSTs to the IR hub at /api/ir-cases to open or link a case. The hub resolves the client by platform_client_id, then by client name, and never creates duplicates when the platform id is present.

client_id.description: The module's own client id, informational only.

case_ref.description: An open hub case number to attach to; blank opens a new case.

summary.description: The case title when a new case is opened.

title.description: Same text as summary; kept for callers that sent title before summary existed.
